homeric_keys.order: Independent lexicographic product1..6 checked against pre-engine fixture; face label136=(1,3,6), editorial ordinal18

numerical_audit.distinctions: Three-d6 unordered56, five-astragaloi unordered56 and five-astragaloi sum24 are different outcome spaces. Equal cardinality does not identify traditions or mappings. Five-d6 unordered252 and sum26 are distinct again.
numerical_audit.multiplicity: For a fixed multiset of n independent equally weighted labels, ordered multiplicity is n! / product(count_i!). Sorted outcomes are generally not uniform. Sum probabilities aggregate these multiplicities; uniform-sum sampling is a different convention.
numerical_audit.assumptions: Uniform1/216,1/1024 or1/7776 ordered probabilities are conditional hypothetical independent fair-label models only. Real astragalos landing probabilities are not established by four named sides. Manual input has no software-draw probability.

proposed_contract.manual: Exact named source profile, known mark or separately specified validated face tuple; raw declared order and canonical outcome key both retained; source annotations, user context, rights/hash and deterministic JSON/Markdown replay
proposed_contract.unknowns: Invalid mark, impossible face, unsupported variation, absent outcome or source gap explicitly rejected/unavailable; do not silently reroll manual input
proposed_contract.replacement: Single-lot first scope. Later multi-draw profile explicitly fixes with/without replacement, population identity/order and duplicate behavior.
proposed_contract.seeded: Optional later only; define independent versioned protocol, UTF8 byte framing, domain including37/profile/catalog/hash, deterministic byte stream, rejection sampling, consumption trace and exact vectors. Preserve all inherited RNG protocols unchanged.
proposed_contract.rejection: For bounded integerN, independent protocol must reject out-of-range byte/word values rather than biased modulo; source-specific recast13/25 is a separate semantic rejection, with raw and accepted traces. No protocol implemented here.
proposed_contract.reuse: Pure strict JSON, immutable hash/registry/replay helpers only. Do not reuse Bibliomancy passage selector or bone/stone meanings as Cleromancy mapping evidence.
